meta.titre: Golden frontier — trous connus / cas durs

verite_terrain.cypher: MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:IMPLIQUE_COMPAGNIE]->(c:Compagnie) WHERE c.nom='EASYJET' RETURN count(DISTINCT i) AS n
MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:IMPLIQUE_COMPAGNIE]->(c:Compagnie) WHERE c.nom='AIR ALGERIE' RETURN count(DISTINCT i) AS n
MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:IMPLIQUE_COMPAGNIE]->(c:Compagnie) WHERE c.nom='TRANSAVIA' RETURN count(DISTINCT i) AS n
MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:IMPLIQUE_AERONEF]->(a:TypeAeronef) WHERE a.label='A320 / 320' RETURN count(DISTINCT i) AS n
MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:IMPLIQUE_AERONEF]->(a:TypeAeronef) WHERE a.label='Boeing 737-800 / 738' RETURN count(DISTINCT i) AS n
MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:LOCALISE_EN]->(l:Lieu) WHERE l.label='Piste' RETURN count(DISTINCT i) AS n

questions.question: Combien d'incidents sur les parkings avions ?

verite_terrain.cypher: MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:LOCALISE_EN]->(l:Lieu) WHERE l.label='Parking avions' RETURN count(DISTINCT i) AS n
MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:EN_PHASE_DE_VOL]->(p:PhaseVol) WHERE p.label='Décollage' RETURN count(DISTINCT i) AS n
MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:EN_PHASE_DE_VOL]->(p:PhaseVol) WHERE p.label='Stationnement' RETURN count(DISTINCT i) AS n
MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:EN_PHASE_DE_VOL]->(p:PhaseVol) WHERE p.label='Atterrissage' RETURN count(DISTINCT i) AS n
MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:DE_TYPE]->(t:TypeEvenement) WHERE t.label='FOD' RETURN count(DISTINCT i) AS n
MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:DE_TYPE]->(t:TypeEvenement) WHERE t.label='Collision aviaire' RETURN count(DISTINCT i) AS n
MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:DE_TYPE]->(t:TypeEvenement) WHERE t.label='Dysfonctionnement du SSLIA' RETURN count(DISTINCT i) AS n
MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:DE_TYPE]->(t:TypeEvenement) WHERE t.label='Problème avitaillement' RETURN count(DISTINCT i) AS n

questions.question: Combien d'incidents sous responsabilité du SSLIA ?

verite_terrain.cypher: MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:RESPONSABLE]->(s:Service) WHERE s.label='SSLIA' RETURN count(DISTINCT i) AS n
MATCH (i:IncidentSecu) WHERE i.est_significatif=true RETURN count(i) AS n
MATCH (i:IncidentSecu) WHERE i.severite IN ['4 - élevé','5 - intolérable'] RETURN count(i) AS n

questions.question: Combien de collisions aviaires impliquant Air France ?

verite_terrain.cypher: MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:DE_TYPE]->(:TypeEvenement {label:'Collision aviaire'}) MATCH (i)-[:IMPLIQUE_COMPAGNIE]->(:Compagnie {nom:'AIR France'}) RETURN count(DISTINCT i) AS n

questions.question: Combien d'incidents FOD sur la piste ?

verite_terrain.cypher: MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:DE_TYPE]->(:TypeEvenement {label:'FOD'}) MATCH (i)-[:LOCALISE_EN]->(:Lieu {label:'Piste'}) RETURN count(DISTINCT i) AS n

questions.question: Combien d'incidents au décollage impliquant EasyJet ?

verite_terrain.cypher: MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:EN_PHASE_DE_VOL]->(:PhaseVol {label:'Décollage'}) MATCH (i)-[:IMPLIQUE_COMPAGNIE]->(:Compagnie {nom:'EASYJET'}) RETURN count(DISTINCT i) AS n

questions.question: Quelle compagnie a le plus d'incidents ?

verite_terrain.cypher: MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:IMPLIQUE_COMPAGNIE]->(c:Compagnie) RETURN c.nom AS v, count(DISTINCT i) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Quelle est la phase de vol la plus fréquente ?

verite_terrain.cypher: MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:EN_PHASE_DE_VOL]->(p:PhaseVol) RETURN p.label AS v, count(DISTINCT i) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Quel type d'événement est le plus fréquent sur la piste ?

verite_terrain.cypher: MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:LOCALISE_EN]->(:Lieu {label:'Piste'}) MATCH (i)-[:DE_TYPE]->(t:TypeEvenement) RETURN t.label AS v, count(DISTINCT i) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1
